author: failure2611
body:
First of all: don't worry too much, you will unlock it all eventually. 
I started with playing Valhalla classes as well as it is somewhat less depending on equipment as harshly as the others early on. 
The calls are actually pretty useful but you need to check on the different followers for it to be really practical. 
You basically shift their action pattern by it. There's a couple followers, that e.g. have a very high buff rate but low casting rate. If you want them to attack with their spell more than actually buffing, you can use a call for that - and so on. 

For example the black dragon (I think it's called) is a very strong early pet as the damage and action rate are both high and you wouldn't need a call to change that, but for others it can come in useful at some point and time. 

Besides that, just unlock what sound the most fun to you and explore the classes. 

To some extend you can unlock different classes already early on because you actually have an achievement for unlocking number x of classes that will return you some of the orns spent. 

Definitely unlock the druid class, as that will give you the moste used buffs (bears might etc.) to boost your stats in battle.

author: imKanth
body:
You're too early in the game to bother choosing a way for "the end game stages".
Also you'll unlock every class soon enough (you need some of their spells/skills on many classes) so the question you should ask yourself is which gameplay/class do you enjoy the most.
In endgame, you'll play one main class and many other to ease the farming of som content.
So play something you enjoy, male it your main class and enjoy !
